study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Brain Structural Phenotype of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using the Normative Model

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression normative model to predict factor weights.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we developed a normative model by training a GPR on the ABIDE II TD cohort (29), using age and gender as covariates to predict weights (Figure 1E).
